queries.name: BHK Demo: External to Privileged Node Path
queries.description: External traffic reaches the intentionally privileged demo pod, which has an escape-relevant path to its node.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(external:BHK_External)-[:BHK_ExternalRoutesTo]->(:BHK_Service)-[:BHK_RoutesTo]->(pod:BHK_Pod)-[:BHK_CE_PRIV_MOUNT|BHK_mountedKubelet]->(node:BHK_Node)
WHERE external.cluster = 'bhk-demo' AND pod.namespace = 'bhk-demo'
RETURN p
LIMIT 25

queries.name: BHK Demo: External to Secret
queries.description: The demo pod mounts its service account token, whose RBAC role can read a synthetic Secret.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s:BHK_External)-[*1..4]->(t:BHK_Secret)
WHERE s.cluster = 'bhk-demo-2' AND t.name = 'synthetic-api-credential' AND t.namespace = 'bhk-demo'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000
